pending.item: provider credential for the fleet profile (owner act): the assistant's model-quality role answer and the model-conducted onboarding conversation cannot run. The deterministic stub route produced no provider call on this install (stub-turn probes recorded). What ran instead: fixture assistant records, onboarding to `active` through the product protocol with fixture answers (stand-in for the employee's own words), and one real fleet agent session per cast member.

hosted shareable non-localhost URL + DNS name + second-device reachability: not built in this strike. The fixture origin (https://lf-host-01.example-tailnet.ts.net:8443) is a made-up name that never resolves, the current host binds 127.0.0.1 only, and a dedicated host/DNS name are owner acts out of scope (no purchase, no DNS work). Device-approval via a second device therefore cannot be shown; the host-side device registry is covered as a stand-in under R4.

phone surface (PACKAGE-PENDING: no phone client; a phone cannot use the fleet join — SCENARIOS.md F5 / package boundary item 6): "Add this phone" and the manager approval on the phone cannot be shown, and the desktop-off answer test needs the host agent runtime/model credential. Host-side device registry row for the phone recorded as a stand-in (operator-registered, approved).

voice/message flow — voice surface PACKAGE-PENDING (P20-F5): no voice button, dictation client, transcript round trip or voice-control badge exists on the installed plugin; the Windows-only surfaces are stand-in/pending, never clean. Only the fixture's written-voices check ran (labelled: not the voice surface).
